title: Identity & Operational Verification
subtitle: Submit government and agricultural credentials to unlock direct marketplace trade
status_unverified_desc: Identity and operating credentials not yet submitted. Verification is required before publishing produce listings or entering trade negotiations.
status_pending_desc: Verification documents are under administrative review. Direct marketplace trade communications will be unlocked once approved.
status_verified_desc: Account credentials have been verified by AgriDirect administrators. Full access to marketplace listings, negotiations, and trade agreements is active.
status_rejected_desc: Previous verification submission could not be approved. Please review administrator notes on the verification page and resubmit updated documents.
guidelines_farmer: Farmers must submit a valid government photo ID and a land record (7/12 extract, Patta) or Kisan Credit Card passbook.
guidelines_buyer: Commercial buyers must provide a GSTIN certificate, Incorporation Certificate, or municipal trade license.
admin_review_notice: Verification submissions are reviewed within 24-48 business hours by the platform moderation team.
